name: defending_player_master_of_diversion
note: Master of Diversion: 'Whenever this creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls.' (CR 508.5). The only legal target is the defending player's Bear, so the trigger takes it without an ask: P0's own Goat is not a legal target. The tapped Bear cannot block, so the Master's 2 damage reaches P1. Red on main b02d7fc: the sentence did not parse, so nothing was tapped.
